Return the schema object with sourceFingerprint and sourceText copied exactly, unit minute, origin 0. changes use exact source phrase spans (start inclusive/end exclusive, source text slice); changes may be empty. issues are strings. A human must inspect and confirm before any planning. No gold solution or expected classification is provided.
